run_experiment_evaluation: run a python script that reloads a BenchMarkRL experiment from a checkpoint file and evaluates it
reload_experiment_from_file: reload a BenchMarkRL experiment from a checkpoint .pt file using reload_experiment_from_file
evaluate_restored_experiment: evaluate a restored BenchMarkRL experiment by calling the evaluate method on the experiment object
run_mappo_checkpoint_eval: run evaluation on a MAPPO algorithm checkpoint for the VMAS balance task using BenchMarkRL
run_experiment_from_checkpoint_path: run a BenchMarkRL experiment evaluation by providing a path to a saved checkpoint file
